ud6.4:13.3: Seated to one side, those mendicants said to the Buddha:
ud6.4:14.1: “Sir, several ascetics, brahmins, and wanderers who follow various other religions are residing in Sāvatthī, holding different views, beliefs, and opinions, relying on different views—
ud6.4:15.1: There were some ascetics and brahmins who had this doctrine and view:
ud6.4:15.2: ‘The cosmos is eternal. This is the only truth, anything else is futile.’ …
ud6.4:15.3: they were fighting, quarreling, and disputing, continually wounding each other with barbed words:
ud6.4:15.5: Such is not Truth, such is!’”
ud6.4:16.5: Such is not Truth, such is!’
